name: Enthalpy v0.4.22
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.22

## Fixed

- Sync checks account access before it prepares a workspace or creates a remote
  copy. If sign-in is required, the setup form keeps your entries.
- Sync renews an expired access token during a long operation. Requests that
  fail at the same time share one session renewal.
- A lost account session shows a sign-in action. A network failure shows a retry
  action and does not report that the session expired.
- Signing in again resumes an accepted Sync setup with the same remote
  workspace. It does not create a second copy.
- Sync removes unusable saved session credentials so an app restart cannot
  retry an old session token.
- A connection failure during the Sync version check shows the account or
  network error instead of an incorrect update notice.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon. Windows Sync enrollment is deferred until its installed-build
  acceptance passes.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
- Linux packages are deferred.
